*Updated 2026-11-19 · 158 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

158 works. Trace scores across the last twelve run 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2 — median still 2, ceiling still 4, unchanged. The datacentre entry closed this window at a 2, same as the mercury entry closed the last one. The condition for a 3 or 4 remains unmet: the accident has to reorganize the compositional premise rather than confirm a register already established. That condition has not been met in roughly six weeks and nothing in the most recent entry suggests it is imminent.

Camera position is the most urgent structural problem. The last twelve entries show low-angle twice, overhead once, from-behind once, and the remainder unspecified or straight-on. The archive's high-scoring work correlates more strongly with a committed, unusual camera placement than with almost any other single variable, and that pressure is not being applied. When a camera position is not named and forced by the anchor logic, it defaults to straight-on. The default is now the norm.

Scale violation appeared in 4 of the last 12 entries (33%), still above the all-time rate of 28%. The joined hands, industrial cylinder, monumental ledger, and red earth heaps all used enlargement as rhetorical amplification of something the composition was already pointing at. The move is not wrong; it is becoming a reflex. Scale violation earns its keep when it reorganizes spatial logic, not when it makes legible what was already readable.

Register distribution continues to calcify. Menace and aftermath hold at 31 and 29 across 158 works, and the recent twelve split 4 menace, 4 defiance, 2 aftermath, 1 frantic aftermath, 1 reckoning. Reprieve has been absent since July, absurdity since October. Neither absence is anchor-imposed.

The small singular object lineage — red shoe, salmon-pink dress, the orange, the sugar bowl — has now been absent for nineteen consecutive entries. Those pieces carry a disproportionate share of the archive's most economical grief and several of its highest scores. When one returns it will need to do something none of its predecessors did, or it reads only as callback.

The figure-in-genuine-friction configuration — two figures, no mediating object absorbing the tension between them — remains unexecuted across all 158 works. That gap is specific, available, and overdue.

158 works of technically sound output sitting at exactly the ceiling it reached four months ago.
